messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected for customer NimbusCare (VPC: eu-west-1). Deployment: dedicated-canary. 5xx > 20% over 5m window. Alert ID INC-20260315-5698. Auto-fallback did not engage.

maria: ack — I'm on it, taking on-call. Starting investigation now.

maria: quick summary: canary push (artifact sha=abc1234) to reserved pool nimbus-eu-west-canary. Observed errors originate from model-worker containers, elevated OOM/killed restarts in pod set.

rohit: looking at recent logs for pod nimbus-canary-2, saw repeated GC/oom_kill entries and worker crash loop. sample log:

```
Worker(2) ERROR: allocation failed, attempted 2.4GB > available 1.8GB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "inference_worker.py", line 412, in run
    allocate_kv_cache(batch_size)
  OSError: unable to allocate memory
```

jun: recommend immediate pinback to previous stable artifact sha=zyx9876 and quarantine the canary to stop bleed into the reserved pool. Steps I propose:
- rwctl deploy rollback --customer NimbusCare --env eu-west-1 --artifact zyx9876  # pins previous artifact
- rwctl pool scale --pool nimbus-eu-west-canary --replicas 0  # drain canary
- rwctl tenant isolate --customer NimbusCare --pool quarantine-eu-west  # move customer to quarantine pool

amy: +1 to pinback + isolate. If we don't isolate, neighbor tenants might see disruption because reserved pool autoscaler could rebalance.

maria: executing pinback now. Running command:

```
$ rwctl deploy rollback --customer NimbusCare --env eu-west-1 --artifact zyx9876
INFO: initiating rollback for NimbusCare in eu-west-1
INFO: updating reservation tags, applying pinned artifact zyx9876
```

maria: pinback command returned success, starting canary scale-down. Running pool scale: `rwctl pool scale --pool nimbus-eu-west-canary --replicas 0`

jun: pool scale succeeded, pods terminating gracefully. cluster event snippet:

```
EVENT: pod/nimbus-canary-0 Terminating (Reason: PreStop)
EVENT: pod/nimbus-canary-1 Terminated (ExitCode: 0)
```

ellen: FYI I'm messaging the customer now — letting them know we detected an elevated error rate during their canary, rolling back to the previously pinned artifact and isolating traffic. ETA 15m. @maria pls include any RCA notes when available.

maria: customer notified. customer success asked for ETA window; gave 15-20m and offered status callback.

rohit: metrics update: 5xx rate dropped from 22% -> 1.8% within ~2 minutes after pinback. latency back to baseline 95th. Monitoring continues (watching for regressions).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: ALERT RESOLVED: 5xx rate returned to baseline for NimbusCare canary. Please create follow-up issue: Investigate memory regression in runtime v2.4.1 for model worker allocation behavior. Tagging: @rohit @amy.

maria: handing off to next owner for postmortem and long-term fix — @rohit you have the investigation. I'll close this live incident channel after 30m of clean metrics.

rohit: ack — I'll run heap snapshots against the artifacts and check kernel memory accounting for quantized kernels. Creating tracking ticket now.

jun: internal note: consider adding an automated canary memory guard (reject canary with >X% OOMs) and a safe-fallback that automatically pins back to last-good artifact for customer-scoped rollouts.

ellen: customer updated: they acknowledged and appreciate the prompt rollback and the prep for postmortem.

maria: closing actions: 1) Confirmed rollback success, 2) Customer notified, 3) Ticket created INC-1945206789-rca assigned to @rohit/@amy. Will follow up with postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Logging incident closure. Severity downgraded. Please file a post-incident writeup and link any relevant logs/artifacts.
